doc.title: Bolt vNext — Cloudflare-Native Architecture Plan

excluded: AI agent orchestration and filesystem mutation guardrails
Cloud runtime preview (server-side rendering of preview)

goals: Local-first UX with optimistic edits and deterministic convergence
Sub-100ms perceived interactions for typical edits
Scales to ~1M active users with launch spikes
No D1/R2 calls on realtime hot path
non_goals: Perfect global ordering beyond CRDT semantics (CRDT handles convergence)

high_level_flow: Browser sends patch to backend over WebSocket
Worker authenticates/authorizes and routes to Project Durable Object
Project DO applies patch, sequences, broadcasts to collaborators
Project DO persists asynchronously (snapshots/patch logs to R2, pointers/metadata to D1)
On restart, Project DO rehydrates from D1 pointer + R2 snapshot (+ optional patch replay)

browser.name: Browser Runtime
responsibilities: Run full-stack app locally (dev server, bundler, HMR) within WebContainers
Maintain local CRDT replica and apply local edits instantly
Derive file contents from CRDT and write them into WebContainer filesystem
Receive remote patches and merge deterministically
Trigger preview updates via filesystem watchers/HMR (decoupled from persistence ack)

stores.name: Local CRDT replica
stores.notes: Authoritative for local UX; converges via CRDT merges

stores.name: WebContainer filesystem
stores.notes: Derived from CRDT; treated as a render target

steps: Update derived file in WebContainer FS
Update derived file in WebContainer FS

worker.name: Cloudflare Worker (Edge Front Door)
responsibilities: Authorize project access (via D1 membership lookup + caching strategy)
Route WebSocket connections to correct Project DO instance (by project_id)
Rate limit and protect DO from abuse (per user/project)
Expose REST endpoints for metadata (create/list projects, invites, etc.)
hot_path_rules: Worker must not call D1 on every edit; only at connection establishment / session refresh
WebSocket upgrade should validate auth + membership before attaching to DO

steps: Check membership/role for project_id (D1 read + cache where safe)
Upgrade and attach WebSocket to DO
Return response (no DO involvement unless needed)

durable_object.name: Project Durable Object
responsibilities: Single authority per project for sequencing + broadcasting patches
Hold active CRDT document state in memory (authoritative for session)
Persist snapshots/patch logs to R2 asynchronously
Maintain durable pointers/metadata updates in D1
Rehydrate from storage on cold start (D1 pointer -> R2 snapshot -> optional patch replay)

in_memory_state.crdt_state: CRDT document instance or serialized state in memory
in_memory_state.seq: Monotonic sequence for patches broadcast ordering (within DO)
in_memory_state.dirty: boolean or patch counter since last snapshot

rules: No D1 or R2 operations on patch apply
Persist asynchronously via alarm or microtask queue
steps: Validate patch shape and size limits
Broadcast patch to all peers (including metadata: seq, actor)

triggers: Every N patches (e.g., 500-2000 depending on snapshot size)
snapshot_strategy.ordering_invariant: Write R2 first, then D1 pointer second (avoid dangling pointers)

async_rules: Retry D1 pointer updates idempotently if R2 write succeeded
Handle orphaned blobs via periodic compaction/reconciliation

steps: Read project_state for project_id to get latest_snapshot_id
Join to project_snapshots to obtain r2_key
Optionally replay patch log if using patch log strategy

r2.name: Cloudflare R2
r2.role: Immutable object storage for large blobs

stores.name: Snapshots
stores.read_pattern: DO rehydration on cold start; historical restore
stores.write_pattern: Async from DO on snapshot triggers

stores.name: Patch logs (optional)
stores.description: Append-only patches between snapshots to reduce snapshot frequency
stores.write_pattern: Async from DO (batch write every K patches)

stores.name: Binary assets
stores.write_pattern: Uploaded via Worker with auth, stored by hash

notes: R2 never writes to D1 directly; the DO coordinates both
Snapshots are immutable; update pointers in D1 instead of overwriting blobs

d1.name: Cloudflare D1
hot_path_rules: Reads primarily during WebSocket connect/auth + DO recovery
Writes primarily during async snapshot pointer updates + metadata mutations

durable_object_memory: Active CRDT state for currently active projects
d1: Pointers to latest snapshot and patch offsets

realtime_edit.path: Browser -> WebSocket -> Worker -> Project DO -> broadcast -> Browsers
notes: Local preview update happens before network send (optimistic)
DO sequencing used only for broadcast ordering; CRDT ensures convergence

d1_reads: project_members by (project_id, user_id) OR project visibility rules
notes: Membership can be cached short-term at Worker, but must be revalidated periodically for revocations

retry_strategy: If D1 fails after R2 success, retry pointer update idempotently
Maintain reconciliation job/logic to find orphan blobs if necessary

durable_object_recovery.path: DO -> D1 read pointer -> R2.get(snapshot) -> rehydrate -> serve
queries: project_state + join to project_snapshots for r2_key

project_metadata_change.path: Browser -> Worker REST -> D1 write -> return

asset_upload.path: Browser -> Worker (signed upload or proxied) -> R2.put(asset by hash) -> D1 optional reference row
notes: Prefer direct-to-R2 signed uploads for large files; Worker issues signed URL after auth

tables.name: users
projects
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE projects (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  visibility TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'private'|'public'
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_projects_owner ON projects(owner_id);

tables.name: project_members
project_snapshots
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE project_snapshots (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, -- versionId
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  r2_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  patch_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_by TEXT, -- user_id or 'system'
  FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_snapshots_project_time ON project_snapshots(project_id, created_at DESC);

tables.name: project_state
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE project_state (
  project_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  latest_snapshot_id TEXT,
  latest_patch_offset INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_snapshot_at INTEGER,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id)
);

tables.name: project_settings
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE project_settings (
  project_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  runtime_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'browser', -- 'browser'|'cloud'
  auto_snapshot_patch_threshold INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000,
  auto_snapshot_interval_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30000,
  max_asset_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 52428800,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id)
);

tables.name: audit_events

hot_queries.name: Permission check on connect
hot_queries.sql: SELECT role FROM project_members WHERE project_id = ? AND user_id = ?;

hot_queries.name: DO recovery pointer lookup (preferred)
hot_queries.sql:
SELECT ps.latest_snapshot_id, s.r2_key
FROM project_state ps
LEFT JOIN project_snapshots s ON s.id = ps.latest_snapshot_id
WHERE ps.project_id = ?;

hot_queries.name: List projects for user
hot_queries.sql:
SELECT p.*
FROM projects p
JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project_id = p.id
WHERE pm.user_id = ?
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC
LIMIT ? OFFSET ?;

snapshot_blob_contract.encoding: binary (preferred) or json (v1 ok, binary later)
notes: Keep snapshot self-contained to allow deterministic recovery
Prefer compression (zstd/gzip) as blob sizes grow

patch_log_contract_optional.chunking: store patches in bounded chunks (e.g., 100-1000 patches per object)

tracing: propagate request_id from Worker to DO

handling: Worker routes to DO (may be new instance)
DO rehydrates from latest snapshot pointer
Clients resync via CRDT (send state vector / request missing updates)

failure_modes_and_handling.failure: R2 write succeeds but D1 update fails
handling: If still failing, keep latest versionId in memory and retry on next alarm
Optional reconciliation job scans recent R2 objects vs D1 rows
Allow realtime editing to continue (hot path unaffected)
Defer snapshot pointer update until D1 recovers
Bound in-memory pending pointer updates to avoid unbounded growth

rules: All WebSocket upgrades must pass through Worker for authz
DO does not accept unauthenticated inbound traffic except via Worker
Membership is enforced on connect and periodically revalidated (revocation window)
Role controls (viewer/editor/owner) enforced for patch submission

notes: Avoid storing secrets in project snapshots; handle environment variables separately (future)
Assets stored in R2 should use signed URLs for private projects
Audit logs store only small JSON metadata

reason: No server-ack ordering required for typing

description: Preview re-renders on local CRDT -> FS changes
Network send and persistence are asynchronous
Remote patches merge and trigger FS updates and HMR

message_types: hello (client->server) includes project_id, client_id, auth context
websocket_protocol.ordering: DO assigns seq for broadcast ordering; CRDT ensures convergence regardless
